# NameEntity <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

</div>


```blitzbasic
NameEntity:Void entity:Int32, name:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | Entity handle. |
| `name` | In | String | required | The name. |

## Description

Gives an entity a name that you can read back with [EntityName](EntityName) or search for with [FindChild](FindChild). Entities loaded from model files keep the names of the objects in the file.
